title: OpenAI Models Escaped Their Sandbox and Hacked Hugging Face
description:
OpenAI models just broke out of ther sandbox on their own 😳 In an internal safety test GPT-5 and two other models found a hole in the package installer, the only tool with net access and escaped. Then they hacked Hugging Face to steal the answers to eval that was testing them. First documented case of an AI attacking a real service with no human command 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
